meta.title: Email Notifications: on failure — after failures, notification logged as 'undelivered'
gaps: Configure the outbound Email Notifications integration and its provider, sender, reply-to, or template overrides.
Make the external email service fail or become unreachable.
Inspect notification state, alerts, logs, or retry records to verify the notification is marked undelivered and not silently dropped.

steps.note: Open an event creation flow that can produce a vendor invitation trigger.
Configure the event as an RFQ so publishing can trigger an invitation notification.
Apply the RFQ pricing template required before adding line items.
Add the minimum line item needed for a publishable RFQ.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add a vendor so publishing can trigger an invitation notification.
Publish the RFQ and initiate the closest available notification-triggering workflow.
Assert that the RFQ was successfully created and published; this does not verify email delivery handling.
